name: Meetnivo Appointments
author: meetnivo

sections.description:
Meetnivo Appointments connects your WordPress site to your Meetnivo public booking page. Visitors can open your business booking page, choose a service or class, and request an appointment.

The plugin includes:

  • A secure connection flow to link a Meetnivo account.
  • A Gutenberg booking button block.
  • The [meetnivo_booking] shortcode.
  • A classic widget for widget areas.
  • Options for button text, style, language, and opening behavior.

External service

This plugin requires a Meetnivo account and connects to https://app.meetnivo.com/ only when an administrator chooses to create an account or sign in to link their business. Public booking pages and the script used to open the booking flow are served by Meetnivo after the administrator configures the plugin.

Review Meetnivo’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Meetnivo Appointments.
  3. Open Meetnivo from the WordPress menu and configure the public booking URL.
  4. Add the Meetnivo Booking Button block or the [meetnivo_booking] shortcode.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Meetnivo account?

Yes. Meetnivo provides the public booking page and manages services, schedules, and appointments. You can create an account from the plugin settings screen.

Can I use the plugin without linking an account?

Yes. You can also configure the Meetnivo public booking URL manually.

What data is shared with Meetnivo?

When linking the plugin, Meetnivo returns the selected business public booking URL. Visitors who open that URL interact directly with Meetnivo. See the Meetnivo Privacy Policy for information about the processing of booking data.

How do I add the button?

Use the “Meetnivo Booking Button” block, add the [meetnivo_booking] shortcode, or place the Meetnivo widget in a widget area.
